title: Pael's Wing
description: You may sacrifice card rewards to Pael. Every [blue]2[/blue] sacrifices, obtain a [gold]Relic[/gold].
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Adds a 'Sacrifice' alternative to every card reward screen. Each sacrifice increments a counter; when the counter reaches the threshold (default 2), automatically obtains a relic from the player's relic pool and triggers a visual animation.
